The Sportshall Athletics proved to be a great success over the winter thanks to a great deal of hard work from Reg Hopkins, Pam Davies and of course Kim and Paul Collier and Mike Kirton who seem to be involved in all aspects of our sport where the youngsters are concerned.
Paul and Kim Collier and Robert and Maritza Ulrych not only bought their sons along to each meeting but also effectively took control of our officiating responsibilities.
Well done Reg Hopkins and Paul and Kim Collier for their enthusiastic organisation. Well done too, Elvis Rimdap, who was awarded the trophy for the best performance in all four races.
Results: Bob Bridges, Kim and Paul Collier, Catherine Eastham, Eric Hall, Reg Hopkins, John Jeffery, Derek Jones, Bill Laws, Charlie Manning, Alan Mead, Pete Mulholland.

You’ve got to hand it to our women’s under 20 team who although only small in number had a terrific season to top the Brent Division of the National Junior League – well done to Team Manager Kim Collier.
